# useExecLogs=true + wrong registry user/password: assert [exec] journals the
# docker login argv (host, -u user, --password-stdin) and never the password
# sentinel. Unreachable registry → login fails fast (soft-fail cycle).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: app needing compose up'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr '\[exec\] workdir='
stderr 'docker login 127.0.0.1:1 -u baduser --password-stdin'
stderr '\[exec\] FAIL.*docker login 127.0.0.1:1 -u baduser --password-stdin'
! stderr 'RegBadPassSentinel99'
stderr 'docker login failed'
stderr 'done duration='

! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' RegBadPassSentinel99 $HOME

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
containerRegistryHost=127.0.0.1:1
containerRegistryUser=baduser
containerRegistryToken=RegBadPassSentinel99
dockerLoginTimeout=5s
useExecLogs=true

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-secrexec
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9998
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-secrexec/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
